extracted.intended_audience: general TED viewers; people interested in stand-up comedy, disability advocacy, and public talks
extracted.subtask_description: A TEDWomen 2013 stage performance by a stand-up comedian (Maysoon Zayid) that mixes personal narrative, disability advocacy, and humor for a general audience. The page is a short promotional/summary blurb for the recorded talk.

rubrics_metrics.name: Openness about personal condition
rubrics_metrics.description: "I have cerebral palsy. I shake all the time,"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Using candid, direct disclosure of a disability as part of the comic setup; frames subject matter honestly and foregrounds lived experience as material for the talk.

rubrics_metrics.name: Self-deprecating / memorable self-comparison
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Employ short, vivid comparisons or one-liners that create a memorable persona and invite laughter through unexpected juxtaposition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Blend of humor and advocacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Maysoon Zayid is described as an actress, stand-up comic, philanthropist and advocate for the disabled.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interweave comedy with activist or philanthropic themes so the performance entertains while advancing awareness or a cause.

rubrics_metrics.name: Energetic, exhilarating delivery
rubrics_metrics.description: The talk is characterized as "exhilarating, hilarious."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aim for a high-energy delivery that elicits both excitement and sustained laughter; pacing and performance vitality are highlighted as key qualities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grace and wit in presentation
rubrics_metrics.description: "With grace and wit, the Arab-American comedian takes us on a whistle-stop tour of her adventures..."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combine polished stage presence ('grace') with sharp comedic writing/insight ('wit'); use concise narrative arcs ('whistle-stop tour') to move quickly through anecdotes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of personal anecdotes as structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Takes the audience on a "whistle-stop tour of her adventures as an actress, stand-up comic, philanthropist and advocate for the disabled."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Structure the talk around a series of personal stories or anecdotes that illustrate different facets of the speaker's life and viewpoint, keeping transitions brisk to maintain audience engagement.
